_comment: Authoring source for the captions screen. iOS-scoped for now — the web app has its own dialogue scenes. No per-word tones: Vietnamese writes them, so ToneMark.of() derives every expected tone from the spelling. Between them these cover all six tones.

phrases.text: Tối nay tôi về nhà ăn cơm với má.
phrases.gloss: Tonight I'm going home to eat with Mom.

phrases.text: Má tôi nấu phở rất ngon.

phrases.gloss: Young rice seedlings grow in the field.

phrases.text: Mã số của tôi là gì?
Chị Phương sống ở phường này.
